Columns.Name: ClaimID
Columns.Description: Claim / visit / encounter number. One row per claim; the same value links the claim's lines on the Line Level sheet.

Columns.Name: PayerName_Raw
Columns.Description: Primary payer / insurance name as it appears in the billing system. Normalized against the Insurance Master on load.

Columns.Name: PayerType
Columns.Description: Financial class (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Self Pay, ...).

Columns.Name: ClinicName
Columns.Description: Clinic / facility / account name. Drives clinic scoping in the AR Workbench.

Columns.Name: FirstBilledDate
Columns.Description: First billed date (MM/DD/YYYY). Drives timely-filing and days-to-bill.

Columns.Name: CPT Code X Units X Modifier Orginal
Columns.Description: The claim's CPT string as billed (e.g. 87798x12, 87481). Optional: the load also builds it from the Line Level sheet.

Columns.Name: ChargeAmount
Columns.Description: Total billed (charge) amount for the claim.

Columns.Name: InsuranceBalance
Columns.Description: Open insurance balance. This is the AR the Workbench works.

Columns.Name: CheckDate
Columns.Description: Check / deposit date of the latest payment (MM/DD/YYYY).

Columns.Name: ClaimStatus
Columns.Description: Current claim status (Paid, Denied, No Response, Adjusted, Partially Paid, ...).

Columns.Name: DenialCode
Columns.Description: Claim-level denial code(s), e.g. CO-16, CO-50. Separate several with a comma. Required on denied claims for the denial queues.
